hook: One Rust thread uploading 36 gigabytes per second.

beats.say: ServiceRadar's Longshore is about twenty-five thousand lines of Rust: one io_uring ring per core, no locks on the data path, all allocation at startup.
One thread on a Graviton4 with a 300 gigabit card uploads to S3 at 36.4 gigabytes per second, or 16.7 with a checksum on every body.
On a Samsung PCIe 5 drive it writes at 13.1 and reads at 14.9 gigabytes per second, the drive's rated speed.
